summary: The scenario has several major issues related to the flags in the 'Identify the Command-and-Control Server' and 'Determine the Exfiltration Port' levels. The flags are too obvious and can be found without doing the task. Additionally, there are minor issues with the hint hierarchy and actionability in these levels. The 'Locate the Ransom Note' level meets all the requirements.
